project: Wuxia Life P112 Merchant Martial Patron Endgame Playable Implementation
description: Lightweight implementation of merchant_martial_patron endgame / final legacy stage (商武终局回响). Strictly follows P111 contract: 1 auto echo event + expression updates, 3 variants (担/孤/传), no stat changes, merchant-martial patron flavor.

userStories.title: Wire patron endgame echo event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the patron endgame echo event wired so players encounter a final covenant settlement echo with 3 variants keyed on late-life branch.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure merchant_patron_endgame_echo_* auto event(s) in sample-lines-spine.json
Trigger: merchant_patron_late_life_done + age 60-65 + mutex guards + exclude orthodox/demonic seed
3 conditional branches keyed on late-life marker (covenant_bound / isolated_merchant / sustainable_covenant)
Set merchant_patron_endgame_echo_done + merchant_patron_endgame_identity_done + branch marker per branch
No stat changes
Do not unset merchant_patron_late_life_done
Event placed after late-life events in spine
No new event framework or scheduler
P102-P110 existing evidence does not regress
Typecheck passes

Expression priority: endgame_echo_done > late_life_done > payoff_done > pressure > on-ramp

No new UI components
Typecheck passes
